name: id
business_description: Unique row identifier for this online booking detail.

name: created_at
business_description: Timestamp when the record was created.

name: modified_at
business_description: Timestamp when the record was last modified.

name: modified_by
business_description: User who last modified the record.

name: status
business_description: Lifecycle status of the detail row.

name: booking_amount
business_description: Amount booked on this online booking.

name: booking_amount_required
business_description: Whether a booking amount must be paid for this item.

name: maxno_booking_allowed
business_description: Maximum number of bookings allowed for this item.

name: repurchase_threshold
business_description: Stock level at which repurchase of the item is triggered.

name: restrict_maxno_booking
business_description: Whether the maximum number of bookings is restricted.

name: total_non_crop_distributed
business_description: Total quantity of non-crop items distributed.

name: upload_document
business_description: Reference to the document uploaded with the booking.

name: crop_noncrop_name_id
business_description: Identifier of the crop or non-crop item in the booking.

name: online_booking_id
business_description: Reference to the online booking this detail row belongs to.

name: sub_assistance_id
business_description: Identifier of the subsidy assistance component linked to the item.

name: grant_id
business_description: Identifier of the grant linked to this booking.

name: total_booking_allowed
business_description: Total number of bookings allowed for this item.

name: document_upload_validity
business_description: Validity period of the uploaded document, in days.
